title: Training Sheet: The Pet-Damage Loss Allowance on Roamhaven Listings Pet Fees
content:
# Training Sheet — The Pet-Damage Loss Allowance

*Host Support training, Roamhaven Listings.*

## The rule in one paragraph

On top of the standard pet-fee ceiling, a listing may carry a pet-damage loss allowance, worked out on the day of the pet-fee reset. The verified losses of the Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims in the pet damage category that the claims team approved and that were filed on the listing within the pet-claim look-back are added up. When they come to **$1500.00 or more**, the pet-damage loss allowance is **$30.00**; when they are above zero but below $1500.00, it is **$10.00**; when there are none, there is no pet-damage loss allowance. The allowance is added to the listing's pet-fee ceiling.

## Questions and answers

**Which loss figure is added up — the amount the host claimed, or something else?**
The verified loss: the loss the claims team verified on each approved claim.

**Which claims contribute?**
Only approved HostCover claims in the pet damage category, filed on the listing within the pet-claim look-back.

**What if the verified losses come to exactly $1500.00?**
That is "$1500.00 or more"; the allowance is $30.00.

**And $1499.99?**
Above zero but below $1500.00; the allowance is $10.00.

**A listing has no approved pet-damage claim in the look-back. Is there any loss allowance?**
No. With no such losses there is no pet-damage loss allowance.

## Worked case (hypothetical claims)

Two approved pet-damage claims fall within a listing's look-back, with verified losses of $640.00 and $910.00. Together they come to $1550.00, which is $1500.00 or more, so the pet-damage loss allowance is $30.00.
